items.name: DC Hyd Cube Open Jan 2027

venue.name: Sindhu Sadan
venue.address: 9FVH+65G, Hira Hall, Beside Luminous One Continent Hotel, King Koti Road, BogulKunta Road, Abids, Hyderabad, Telangana

items.information: All the participants are expected to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events. **ALL PARTICIPANTS HAVE TO BE AT THE VENUE ATLEAST 40 MINUTES BEFORE THE START OF THEIR EVENT. LATE COMERS WILL NOT BE ALLOWED TO PARTICIPATE.** Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/y4aZ08M.png) **Polski:** Serdecznie zapraszamy na drugi turniej FTO Tour - serii dziewięciu zawodów w Południowej Polsce z FTO jako główną konkurencją! Partnerem wydarzenia jest Powiatowe Centrum Kultury w Strzelcach Opolskich. ----------------------- ![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png) **English:** We cordially invite you to the second competition of the FTO Tour – a series of nine competitions in Southern Poland featuring FTO as the main event! Powiatowe Centrum Kultury in Strzelce Opolskie is the competition's partner.

items.name: Imagination Station B 2027

venue.name: [Imagination Station](https://www.imaginationstationtoledo.org/)
venue.details: Exploration Center - on the lower floor next to the cafeteria

items.information: This competition is at the Imagination Station science center. Non-competing family members and spectators are **required to purchase general admission** to the science center to enter the competition. Competitors will pick up their lanyards at the front desk and will not need to purchase general admission. Imagination Station opens at 12pm - you will not be able to get in earlier. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbWlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8843e254b05ca879fa0ab066c46e77b7920e76c8/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png)
